units.source_text: 他猜中了一半，可我对这种推理却无动于衷，表情毫无变化。

en.t: He had guessed half of it correctly, but I was unmoved by this sort of reasoning, and my expression did not change at all.
I felt a little smug about that.

units.source_text: 鹤川就像喜欢制作昆虫标本的少年经常所做的那样，

en.t: Tsurukawa was like a boy who loves making insect specimens, as such boys often do,

units.source_text: 把人的感情分门别类，整齐地收藏在自己房间的精巧的小抽屉里，

en.t: sorting human feelings into categories and neatly storing them away in the delicate little drawers of his own room,

units.source_text: 不时取出来，实际检验检验，他有这种乐趣。

en.t: taking them out from time to time and testing them in practice; that was the sort of pleasure he had.
